artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight in combat with a dragon, observed by a figure in the background. The scene is detailed within a circular frame, showcasing a knight on horseback battling a dragon. The dragon is depicted with its mouth open, claws outstretched, and scales. The knight is poised with a lance pointed at the dragon. In the background, a figure in robes observes from a distance, with a castle on a hill further back. Shading and line work bring texture and dimension to the figures, horse, and landscape.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a robe, holding an object in both hands. The man has a beard and curly hair, and is holding a small book with a lamb on it, with a halo and a cross-staff.

artworks.title: Saint Martin Dividing His Cloak
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. The person on the left is standing, holding a sword and a draped fabric. They have curly, medium-length hair, a beard, and are wearing elaborate clothing. The person on the right is kneeling, unclothed, with a strained facial expression looking up at the standing figure. The backdrop is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Michael Slaying the Dragon
artworks.description: This print depicts an angelic figure standing and pointing a long staff or spear downward with both hands, aiming at a serpentine creature that lays on the ground. The tall angel's body is turned to us, with their face looking down and to the right. They have curly hair that frames their face and goes down to their shoulders, light skin, and a neutral expression. Their attire consists of long, flowing robes with detailed drapery. Large white wings extend upwards from their shoulders and there is a small cross on top of their head. The creature below them has large horns and a snout, and pointed teeth emerge from its open mouth. Its body is spiny, and it appears to have claws, pincers, and a long, sinuous tail. One of its arms reaches up to grab the spear wielded by the angel. The background is mostly plain paper, with some lines indicating flat ground.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.7 x 11.3 cm (6 3/16 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person tied to a tree with their arms and feet bound. They have wavy hair, a serene facial expression, and are pierced by multiple arrows. The person is mostly unclothed with a cloth around the waist. The background is a barren landscape with minimal details.

artworks.title: Saint Stephen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.3 x 11.4 cm (6 7/16 x 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright in a full-body portrait. The individual faces forward while holding a palm branch in their left hand and adjusting their garment with their right hand. They have short, curly hair and a calm expression. The person wears a long robe with intricate folds and textures. No other objects or jewelry are visible around them. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure. The artwork is detailed with clear lines and shading.

artworks.title: Saint Agnes
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with long, curly hair, wearing flowing robes with intricate detailing. They have closed eyes and a calm expression, holding a palm frond in one hand and a book in the other. There is a small lamb or sheep at their feet, and a plain background emphasizes the person and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara
artworks.description: The image depicts a standing figure facing forward, wearing a crown and holding an object in their hands. They have long, wavy hair and are dressed in a flowing gown. In the background, there is a tower-like structure on the left and a mound or hill on the right.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria
artworks.description: The image depicts a female figure standing. She is slightly turned to her right and holds a sword with her left hand, the tip resting on the ground. Her facial features include an oval face, subtle smile, and straight nose. Her long, wavy hair reaches past her waist. She is wearing an elaborate gown with detailed drapery, a cloak over her shoulders, and an ornate crown on her head. She holds a piece of fabric in her right hand. The background is minimal, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: Saint Veronica
artworks.description: The image shows a half-body depiction of a woman standing and holding a cloth with a detailed face imprinted on it. The woman is positioned facing forward, slightly angled, holding the cloth spread between her two outstretched hands. Her facial expression is neutral, and she has delicate features with a serene countenance. Her hair is mostly covered by a layered garment that flows around her head and shoulders. She is dressed in a robe with long sleeves, and the fabric appears to be flowing and textured. The cloth she holds prominently features a realistic illustration of a man's face with long, wavy hair and a full beard. The background is plain and unadorned, providing a neutral backdrop that highlights the central figures in the composition.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This print depicts three people. The central person is a man fully suspended on a large wooden cross, with arms his outstretched and palms nailed to the cross. His head is tilted downward and his eyes are closed. The man has long, wavy hair adorned with a crown of thorns, a short beard, and is mostly unclothed, with a wrinkled cloth tied around his waist. To the left is a person with their head covered in a long cloth, wearing a draped garment. They wear a neutral expression and have a halo around their head, and their head is slightly turned toward the central man. To the right is another figure with a halo and long, curly hair who is wearing a draped robe and holding a book. This person has hollow cheekbones and looks slightly upward towards the center of the print. The ground the figures stand on is rocky, and there are a skull and some stones at the base of the cross. The sky behind the group of people is blank.

artworks.title: The Lion of Saint Mark
artworks.description: This is a print of a creature with the body of a lion and the wings of an eagle, depicted within a circular frame. The creature has a lion's face, mane, and muscular forepaws, with the large, intricately designed wings extending from its back. A flowing ribbon entwines the legs of the creature, and it has a halo around its head. It is in profile, facing the left. The lower portion of the print includes the initials "M + S."

artworks.title: Fourth Wise Virgin
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure of a woman. She is standing with her body slightly turned to the side and her head gently tilted. Her facial features are delicately drawn, with a slightly pointed chin, narrow eyes, and a composed expression. Her hair is adorned with a garland of foliage and partially covered by a sheer veil. She is dressed in a long flowing gown with voluminous sleeves, cinched at the waist. She holds a large cup or chalice with a flame rising from it in both hands, in front of her chest. The background is plain, and the initials "M S" are inscribed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Second Foolish Virgin
artworks.description: The image features a person standing in a slightly sideways position with their head turned downward. The person has delicate facial features and a gentle expression, with hair styled neatly back. They are wearing a long, flowing garment, holding a small, cylindrical object in one hand. The background is plain, and there is an intricate circular design on the ground at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Apprentices Fighting
artworks.description: The image shows two young boys in an action-oriented scene. One boy stands with his left foot against the wall, wearing a long-sleeved tunic, leggings, and long, curly hair. The other boy appears to swing a stick while holding onto the first boy's shoulder or neck. Both boys wear elaborately patterned clothes. Next to them is a stool with objects and a bellows, with a pile of fabric in the corner. The background features plain, textured walls.

artworks.title: Peasant Family Going to Market
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 16.2 x 16 cm (6 3/8 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of a man riding a horse in a countryside setting. The drawing shows the man riding a horse, with another person walking beside them, moving through a rugged terrain with rocks, trees, and hills in the background. The focus is on the details of the horse and the rider's clothing, with additional elements like a structure and other figures in the distance. The style appears to be influenced by medieval or Renaissance art, emphasizing the movement of the travelers in the rural landscape.

artworks.title: Family of Pigs
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.6 x 9.4 cm (2 5/8 x 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of wild boars, including adults and piglets. The artwork shows two large adult wild boars and several smaller piglets engaged in various activities. The adult boars have sharp tusks and bristly fur, while the piglets appear rounded and playful. The landscape is minimal, with a simple suggestion of ground and a backdrop. The artist's initials "M + S" are visible at the bottom of the drawing. The line work is detailed, with an emphasis on textures and the natural appearance of the animals.

artworks.title: Shield with Lion, Held by Angel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel holding a heraldic shield. The image features an angel with flowing robes and curled hair, depicted in a circular frame. The angel has two large wings extending from its back. It is holding a large heraldic shield with an ornate design, which includes a detailed depiction of a lion. The surroundings show detailed shading and line work, adding texture to the drapery.

artworks.title: Shield with Unicorn, Held by Woman
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 7.7 x 7.7 cm (3 1/16 x 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a full view of a seated person within a round frame. The person is seated, facing forward with a serene expression. They wear a robe and hold a shield with a horse image. On their left side, they hold flowers. The background shows floral and plant decorations.

artworks.title: Shield with Swan, Held by Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the knees up, seated in a relaxed position. She has distinct facial features with a gentle expression, her hair styled in an intricate braid wrapped around her head. She is dressed in a long, flowing gown with fitted sleeves, adorned with a small decorative element on the bodice. The gown extends with draped fabric pooling around her. The woman holds a large heraldic shield in her right hand, depicting an image of a swan with an elongated neck. Surrounding her are stylized details of foliage and flowers, enhancing the circular composition. There are no other objects of note or jewelry visible on her. The background is plain, focusing attention on the central figure within the circular frame.

artworks.title: Shield with Lion's Head, Held by Wild Woman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman and child in an allegorical scene. The composition features a central female figure with flowing hair and a wreath of flowers. She is seated and holding a young child. The backdrop consists of large ornamental shapes resembling waves or architectural elements. In the foreground, there is a heraldic shield with a lion's face. The style is detailed with crosshatching and fine line work, reminiscent of Renaissance engraving, with an artistic monogram at the bottom.

artworks.title: Shield with Wings, Held by Peasant
artworks.description: The image shows a coat of arms with an emblem in the center, surrounded by plumed designs. Two birds are perched on a jagged edge, with a figure leaning over the coat of arms. The figure looks thoughtful, with one hand on their face and the other arm resting on the edge next to a plant. The elements are enclosed within a circular border. The style is elaborate and decorative, typical of heraldic designs.

artworks.title: Wild Man Holding a Shield with a Greyhound
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a wild, man-like figure holding a staff and leaning against a decorated shield. The figure is covered in dense foliage or fur, wears a crown of branches and leaves, and rests one hand on the shield. The shield features a depiction of a leaping creature resembling a hound. The scene is enclosed in a circular border with the initials "M+S" below the figure. The background consists of fine lines depicting rough terrain. The style suggests a symbolic or heraldic motif, typical of Renaissance art.
